name: cstk_select_execution
description: Select the absolute session project and execution without creating state. One project per server.

name: cstk_context
description: Inspect selected context, prerequisites and knowledge index before opening a wave.

name: cstk_bootstrap
description: Create Codex state without replacing existing execution. Obtain real initial opt-ins.

name: cstk_optin
description: Record an actual operator opt-in and observed source. Never infer consent.

name: cstk_open_wave
description: Own the current phase and its project hook binding until complete, pause, block or abort.

name: cstk_status
description: Inspect identity, runtime, phase, terminal status and human blocks without advancing.

name: cstk_resume
description: Resume persisted phase. Pending questions require actual identified operator answers.

name: cstk_abort
description: Abort while preserving artifacts/history. Purge backups only on explicit operator request.

name: cstk_handoff
description: Explicitly transfer a paused Claude/unattributed execution with audited prior provenance.

name: cstk_reconcile_governance
description: Apply reviewed governance changes only with both observed hashes and operator authorization.

name: cstk_decision
description: Record an evidenced decision using canonical structural consent gates.

name: cstk_complete
description: Verify persisted evidence and canonical gates, close and advance one phase. Continue authorized remaining phases.

name: cstk_pause
description: Close without advancing with a concrete resumption instruction.

name: cstk_block
description: Register a real human question and blocking decision, then close without advancing.

name: cstk_recover
description: Explicitly reconcile an interrupted wave without advancing. Abandoned owner must match and be proven dead.
